checks.name: Source evidence is reached through real multi-hop relationships
checks.details: 33 evidence paths returned; source and rule revisions are present.

checks.name: Native shortestPath reaches accountable human owners
checks.details: 4 owners returned with measured path lengths.

checks.name: Sixteen coordinators converge on one canonical clarification
Concurrent approvals accept one revision and reject stale writers
checks.details: 1 approval accepted; 15 stale updates rejected; 3 tasks remain pending.

checks.name: Command replay is idempotent and changed payload reuse is rejected
checks.details: Exact replay preserved one decision and one task set; a different payload returned COMMAND_REUSED.

checks.name: Approval never substitutes for implementation evidence
checks.details: Empty evidence and premature resolution were rejected; human work stayed pending.

checks.name: Evidence-backed tasks and a fresh full-domain check resolve the case
checks.details: All tasks retained evidence; exhaustive adopted-rule verification resolved the case; original violation remains stored.

checks.name: Reviewed source changes preserve history and reject stale case evidence
checks.details: Scenario advanced from revision 1 to 2; old source and counterexample remain; 2 stale memories rejected.

checks.name: Tenant definitions, conversations, cases and learned memory remain separate
checks.details: Same visitor, separate tenant graphs: definitions differ as intended and no private conversation, case or learned decision crossed the boundary.

checks.name: An expired agent cannot write after another worker takes ownership
checks.details: Ownership advanced from fence 1 to 2; stale tool and completion writes were rejected.

checks.name: GRAPH.RO_QUERY rejects mutation and stores no forbidden node
checks.details: The database rejected CREATE through the read-only query channel; no forbidden node exists.

checks.name: Acknowledged graph state survives independent client reconnection
checks.details: A new authenticated gateway client read the value after the writing client closed. The gateway executes through the official FalkorDB client. This checks client continuity, not host disaster recovery.

checks.name: Sixteen workers preserve every acknowledged atomic write under concurrent reads
checks.details: 16 workers, 128 acknowledged writes, 128 confirmed reads; p50 10.901 ms, p95 19.544 ms; no lost receipts or increments.

checks.name: Verification fixtures are removed without altering the user workspace
checks.details: Both temporary tenant graphs were deleted. Only this measured report is retained in the requested workspace.

methodology: Real typed graph queries, application mutations and independent client connections. All fixtures use private temporary graphs. Latency measures acknowledged counter writes; counts come from queries after all workers settle.

connection.transport: local HTTP gateway / private Unix socket
